notes.title: Play SUFFOCATE's Demo During Steam's Next Fest ! New patch released !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42340957/83251f8da36ccba18256aa78b7ccab54b8eb62ae.jpg[/img]
SUFFOCATE, a survival horror game developed by Naughty Cow, will be available to demo during Steam's Next Fest this February 24.

SUFFOCATE first released a playable demo during last year's Halloween, allowing players to get a taste of the game's introductory story and explore the Lin family mansion and the mysterious Lian Hua Temple.
For the upcoming Steam Next Fest, the updated demo features enhanced cutscenes, utilizing motion capture technology to make character movements more natural and immersive. Additionally, a new explorable room called the "Tantric Room" has been added to the Lian Hua Temple. Players who choose the "Standard Mode" can enter the room and "take a closer look," offering an up-close experience of the cult rituals depicted in the game.

A demo of ￼SUFFOCATE will be available as part of Steam's Next Fest this February 24. If you're interested, please add it to your wishlist to receive the latest news, and join the official Discord to talk directly to the developers!

HI! Horror gamers!! NaughtyCow is proud to present our second trailer today!!

The trailer exposes new character Senator Guo-Biao Lin, the legislator of Taipei City, who seeks  re-election but is suspected of being caught in a sex scandal? What kind of secret and relationship does he have with the hanged lady in the mansion?   

In the mysterious temple, the believers are holding ceremonies and have bad intentions to.... ,  are there any connection with evil spirits in the mansion?  The unbearable truth awaits.

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is showcasing around 100 discounted games, and offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles!
The sale runs from Aug 4-8 10am PST. And includes live broadcasts to celebrate and showcase the lineup. 

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is the first-ever Steam sales event focusing on promoting games from the SEA region, breaking cultural barriers, and raising awareness for the region’s gaming scene. We introduce awesome games with a local touch, just like the night market culture commonly seen here -- filled with creativity, diversity, and great fun.
